title: HCMC · city streets
extentDescription: Bounding rectangle of the supplied HCMC camera locations, plus 0.01 degrees (~1.1 km) on each side; not the municipal administrative boundary.
coordinates: Local metres: X east, Y up, Z south; equirectangular projection at origin latitude.
assumptions: Road alignments and building footprints are OSM-derived, not surveyed here.
Road widths use OSM width where present, otherwise lanes × 3.2 m or class defaults.
Building heights use height, levels × 3.2 m, or a 10.5 m default.
Bridge decks use 6 m per OSM layer with schematic 70 m approach ramps; not measured elevation.
Tunnels are modelled below the ground plane and are normally hidden.
Terrain is flat; no junction turning simulation, traffic or CCTV capture is running.
Coverage reflects OSM completeness. Missing buildings are not proof of empty land.
Overview road lines are simplified by up to 2 m for display; detailed road tiles use original centreline vertices.
